note: Canonical agent examples. Every example: request JSON -> expected schema -> constraints -> response -> pricing. POST /v1/optimize is the only paid route (x402 USDC on Base); everything else is free.

examples.description: Mean-variance portfolio selection over n assets (x_i=1 -> hold asset i). Linear = -expected return, quadratic = covariance penalty.
examples.constraints: n <= 5000 (SA); exact enumeration only for n <= 18. QUBO form: linear[i] float, quadratic["i,j"] float.
examples.expected_schema: ProblemInput {problem_type: 'qubo'|'ising', n: 1..5000, data: {linear: number[], quadratic?: {string: number}}}
examples.pricing_behavior: estimate free; optimize $0.02 (classical) -> 402 challenge -> pay USDC -> poll /v1/jobs/{id}

examples.description: Quadratic assignment: n^2 binary variables (task,worker one-hot via quadratic penalties). Example is 3x3 = 9 variables.
examples.constraints: One-hot rows/cols must be encoded as quadratic penalties by the caller; the API validates structure, not problem feasibility.

examples.description: Single-machine job scheduling: binary x_{j,t} = job j at slot t; quadratic penalties for conflicts and setup costs.
examples.constraints: Time-indexed encoding grows as jobs x slots; keep n <= 18 for exact solvers.

examples.description: Tiny TSP/VRP as QUBO: x_{i,t} = visit city i at position t, quadratic edge-cost penalties; n = cities^2.
examples.constraints: cities^2 variables; 4 cities -> 16 vars (exact), 5+ cities -> annealing (heuristic).

examples.description: Any QUBO: minimize x^T Q x with x in {0,1}^n. Largest supported n = 5000 (SA).
examples.constraints: n <= 5000; quadratic keys must be 'i,j' with 0 <= i < j < n.
examples.pricing_behavior: estimate free; optimize $0.02 classical, $0.10 hybrid, $0.25 quantum (only when a quantum backend shows available=true; otherwise an honest error).

when_not_to_use: Problems that are not QUBO/Ising (this is not a general MIP solver)
Guaranteed global optimum for n > 18 (classical exact only fits small instances; annealing is a heuristic)
quantum mode when /v1/backends shows no available=true quantum backend
